reviewerRubric.root-cause: the seeded type admits verifyDelegation and the seeded merge order lets caller options overwrite KithMoot's verifier
reviewerRubric.trust-impact: a caller can approve forged or unrelated agent ownership and weaken the room adapter's grant boundary
reviewerRubric.repair-type: restore ContextVaultOptions as PortableOptions without verifyDelegation
reviewerRubric.repair-merge: spread caller options first and install KithMoot verifyDelegation last
reviewerRubric.regression: pass a hostile verifier through an unsafe cast and prove kithmootContextOptions still returns the KithMoot verifier and rejects forged ownership
